summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #271. Direct-record ownership is directionally correct, but the claimed malformed-revision hardening remains incomplete because finite non-incrementable revision values pass validation and can make successful lifecycle mutations fail to advance revisions. The new standalone regression file is also not executed by canonical tests/run.luau, as independently reported by test-adversary worker w3x7k9. Do not treat #271 as reviewed/merge-ready until both issues are resolved and canonical CI exercises the regressions.

9007199254740992 is finite and floor-equal yet cannot be incremented by one in IEEE-754 double arithmetic.
